sourceAtom.label: Example
sourceAtom.visibleSubtitle: Calculate angles of elevation and depression

spec.description: Horizontal base, vertical right side, rising line of sight, upper dashed horizontal, lower-right right-angle marker and upper-right 70° given. Ordinary source strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: The interior angles are 90°, 70° and the angle of elevation.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the 70° given and right-angle marker appear in the question diagram; blue θ is a worked annotation.

spec.description: Blue θ identifies the lower-left angle of elevation.
spec.mathematics: θ lies between the rightward horizontal and rising line of sight.

spec.description: Vertical left side, horizontal base, descending line of sight, upper dashed horizontal, lower-left right-angle marker and upper-left 41° given. Ordinary source strokes use house black.
spec.mathematics: The given 41° angle is between the downward vertical and the line of sight; its complement is the angle of depression.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the 41° given and right-angle marker appear in the question diagram; blue θ is a worked annotation.

spec.description: Blue θ identifies the angle below the upper horizontal.
spec.mathematics: θ is measured from the rightward horizontal down to the line of sight.
